violations.requirement: The index must be in bounds of the slice; otherwise this is undefined behavior.
violations.explanation: node_ref is a pub safe fn. It passes the caller's index i to get_unchecked without checking it against nodes.len(). A safe caller can pass an out-of-bounds index and trigger UB.
